units.rawText: It's been a while since I came to the Oasis, hm... I love it here. There's so much stuff I can do and lots of people to talk to, and I even got to meet a bunch of friends from my homeland!

units.rawText: Still, when it comes to my "home"... I see it differently.

units.rawText: Look, this is the safety tether for my spacesuit. It joins me to the space station. Even the most prodigal of children think of their home from time to time, and this is the kite's string that keeps us from getting lost in space.

units.rawText: As long as we can touch down, we can be ready to move out again at any time to explore more of the unknown—and besides, everyone back home is waiting to hear the good news from us.

units.rawText: Our curiosity and courage will take us far, but it's our feelings and our trust that bind us to home. To everyone, that's what the Oasis is during our days on the cloud.

units.rawText: As long as you're in the Oasis, it can be a place for us to rest our heads and hang up our hats. Am I right, or am I right? Ahahaha, don't be shy~
